program.address_context: Original unrelocated file-backed EE PT_LOAD; named M2 project copied from preserved M1 working project.

provenance.source: Fresh read-only, no-analysis HGExport snapshots of the existing M2 Ghidra project for M12; verified against the original Japanese ELF.
limitations: 0015fc10 reconstructed completely; 0015e420 reconstructed for floor hits only, other paths fail closed.
00145630 and 00144820 are instruction evidence for modeled leaves, not reconstructions.

functions.name: hg_player_grounded
functions.interpretation: Reconstructed in C: vertical speed +430 gravity step (0.08, or 0.03 while +4ad), -2.0 floor, y += speed, 0015e420 floor routine, speed cleared on a floor result.

functions.name: hg_player_floor
functions.interpretation: Reconstructed in C for floor hits: probe origin (position - 2 y), +483/3f9ff2 resets, state 2 -> 1, ground flag +2c3, surface bits +47c, +47e/+480/+481/+483 from the hit record, whole-quad snap to the 3f39a0 hit. No-floor, hazard (5/6/7), special-surface (0x1e00) and +47e == 3 spawn paths fail closed.

functions.name: floor_segment_query
functions.interpretation: Modeled original instructions, not reconstructed: segment from origin + f12 (6.0) y down to the origin through 00144820 (mode 0x2c0 | 1); maintains +2c1/+248 moving-floor fields.

functions.name: scene_segment_query_mode
functions.interpretation: Modeled original instructions, not reconstructed: static-geometry and object segment query used by 00145630 (and by the unsupported 0015e420 paths).
